paragraphs.source_en: After an envoy from Protestant England had been received by Ieyasu and the two countries had concluded a treaty of friendship, Masamune drew close to General Vizcaíno and Sotelo of the old faith. He even posted a proclamation in the main hall of his castle declaring freedom to preach the faith—an act of extraordinary insolence.

paragraphs.source_en: Not only Shogun Hidetada but even Ieyasu took a keen interest in this voyage. But Mataemon perceived that Masamune must have given some hint about the voyage to Matsudaira Tadateru, who had already returned to Edo, and therefore assigned still more men to tighten the watch.

paragraphs.source_zh: 大船预定于九月十五出发。那之前八日，即九月初七，政宗写给女婿忠辉的书函已落入了又右卫门手中。又右卫门深深感到，天下之势，只四字可书——
